newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Concord Land debuts at HK$3.60 per share.
newsitem.headline: Concord Land debuts at HK$3.60 per share.

text.p: Shares of Concord Land Development Co Ltd made their trading debut at HK$3.60 in Hong Kong, compared with their issue price of HK$3.48 per share.
The shares then quickly retreated to HK$3.275.
Concord Land is the Hong Kong and China property division of Pacific Concord Holdings Ltd.

The company offered 300 million shares at HK$3.48 per share, of which 85 percent was placed with institutional investors and 15 percent offered in Hong Kong. The Hong Kong initial public offer was 1.53 times subscribed.
Concord Land is engaged in property development, mainly retail properties and shopping malls, in major cities in China.
